parameters.jsCode: const c=$json.canon_source??{};let records=[];let source_field='none';for(const field of ['characters','character_records','character_candidates']){if(Array.isArray(c[field])){records=c[field];source_field=field;break;}}return[{json:{...$json,character_records:records,character_source_field:source_field}}];

const clean=value=>typeof value==='string'?value.trim().replace(/\s+/gu,' '):'';const records=$json.character_records.map((original_record,source_index)=>{const r=original_record&&typeof original_record==='object'&&!Array.isArray(original_record)?original_record:{};const aliasesTypeValid=r.aliases==null||Array.isArray(r.aliases);const aliasValues=Array.isArray(r.aliases)?r.aliases:[];const aliases=[];const seen=new Set();for(const value of aliasValues){const alias=clean(value);if(alias&&!seen.has(alias)){seen.add(alias);aliases.push(alias);}}const appearanceTypeValid=r.first_appearance_chapter==null||(Number.isInteger(r.first_appearance_chapter)&&r.first_appearance_chapter>0);const aliveTypeValid=r.is_alive==null||typeof r.is_alive==='boolean';return{source_index,original_record,aliases_type_valid:aliasesTypeValid,first_appearance_type_valid:appearanceTypeValid,is_alive_type_valid:aliveTypeValid,record:{name:clean(r.name),identity:clean(r.identity),first_appearance_chapter:appearanceTypeValid&&r.first_appearance_chapter!=null?r.first_appearance_chapter:null,realm:clean(r.realm),appearance:clean(r.appearance),personality:clean(r.personality),relationship_to_protagonist:clean(r.relationship_to_protagonist),is_alive:aliveTypeValid&&r.is_alive!=null?r.is_alive:null,aliases,notes:clean(r.notes),source_chapter_uuid:clean(r.source_chapter_uuid)||$json.canon_context.chapter_uuid}}});return[{json:{...$json,normalized_character_records:records}}];

const valid=[];const invalid=[];for(const item of $json.normalized_character_records){const errors=[];const r=item.record;const nameLength=Array.from(r.name).length;if(nameLength<1)errors.push('Character name is required.');else if(nameLength>100)errors.push('Character name must not exceed 100 characters.');if(!item.aliases_type_valid||!Array.isArray(r.aliases))errors.push('Aliases must be an array.');if(!item.first_appearance_type_valid)errors.push('first_appearance_chapter must be a positive integer or null.');if(!item.is_alive_type_valid)errors.push('is_alive must be a boolean or null.');if(errors.length)invalid.push({source_index:item.source_index,validation_errors:errors,original_record:item.original_record});else valid.push({...r,source_index:item.source_index});}return[{json:{...$json,valid_character_records:valid,invalid_character_records:invalid}}];

const stableId=value=>{let h=2166136261;for(const ch of String(value).normalize('NFKC').toLocaleLowerCase()){h^=ch.codePointAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return(h>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,'0')};const c=$json.canon_context;const generated=$json.valid_character_records.map(record=>({...record,character_uuid:`CHR-${stableId(`${c.novel_uuid}|character|${record.name}`)}`,knowledge_key:`${c.novel_uuid}|character|${record.name.toLocaleLowerCase()}`}));return[{json:{...$json,identified_character_records:generated}}];

## Intake
Accept and validate the WF-006 Canon contract.

## Validation
Canon-level errors reject; record-level errors remain isolated.

## Character Normalization
Normalize only supplied records. Empty input is valid.

## Knowledge Object Generation
Generate IDs, deduplicate names, merge aliases, and report conflicts.

## Output
Summarize and emit the stable Character Knowledge contract.
